description: Fail, fail again. The news today that the former FBI Director James Comey was indicted by a federal grand jury at the request of the Department of Justice could not be more ridiculous, and is bound for the same dust bin as DOJ's first indictment of Comey. If it were not so harmful, it would be funny. At a time when the Department of Justice has jettisoned or shed major portions of its professional legal staff, and those prosectors who are left are compelled by higher authorities to waste time
